description: This file defines a Kotlin singleton object 'ImageCacheUtils' that provides a utility method to clear image caches managed by the Coil image loading library. It is intended for testing or verification scenarios to simulate a first-run state by clearing in-memory and disk caches.

methods.name: clearAllCoilCaches
methods.description: Suspended function to clear Coil's in-memory and disk image caches using a provided Android context.
